_note: Illustrative AgentCard for the docs-squad orchestrator. Field names follow the A2A spec as read on 2026-10-04; the well-known URL path is intentionally NOT asserted here (not verified). Not served by any live endpoint.
name: docs-squad-orchestrator
description: Answers developer questions about GitHub REST API versions 2022-11-28 / 2025-06-01 and Swagger Codegen 2.x/3.x by delegating to a version/deprecation worker and a code-sample worker.

skills.name: Version and deprecation check
skills.description: What changed, was added or was deprecated for an api_version + endpoint, or where a topic lives in the docs.
examples: How did make_latest change between 2022-11-28 and 2025-06-01?

skills.name: Current parameter table and code sample
skills.description: Current parameters (names, types, defaults, allowed values) for one api_version + endpoint, and a minimal sample.
examples: Which visibility values does create_repository accept in 2025-06-01?
